$comment: Synthetic doorstep notes with hand-labelled ground truth. Fields not listed equal the empty record (numbers -1, yes/no 'unknown', deviceType 'none', needs []). Used to measure extraction accuracy on-device vs cloud. No real people.

notes.note: Grandma on oxygen, concentrator dead, spare battery maybe three hours. Baby 8 months, formula for half a day. No clean water.
Older man, lives alone, no AC, says he's fine but it's very hot inside. Water for two days.
Two adults and two kids. Everyone ok. They have water for a week and a generator.
Woman on home dialysis, last session was yesterday morning, machine needs power. Power's out.
Diabetic teenager, insulin in a fridge that's been off since Tuesday, about 3 days of pens left.
Elderly couple, husband uses a walker and can't do stairs, they're on the second floor and the water is rising. Want to leave.
Nobody home I think, curtains closed, no answer.
Man with CPAP, power ok here, he's got enough food. Lives with his son.
Mother, newborn twins, out of formula tomorrow. No car.
Ventilator patient, 72, battery backup 6 hours, family running a small generator but low on fuel.
Three adults, one is 80 and bedbound. Medicine running out, need a pharmacy run.
She uses oxygen but I didn't ask if it's working. Lives alone. Seventy something.
Family of five, kids 3, 6 and 10. No water at all since last night.
Dialysis three times a week, missed Monday's session, it's Wednesday. Needs a ride to the clinic.
Insulin's fine, they have a cooler with ice, two weeks of supply.
Oxygen tanks only, not a machine, about a day left in the tanks. Old lady with her daughter.
Heat's bad. 68-year-old, alone, fan works because power came back.
Suction machine for a disabled son, no power, battery died an hour ago.
Young couple, fine, just want to know where the shelter is. Water for 3 days.
Grandpa in a wheelchair, house flooded downstairs, they need to get out and somewhere to sleep.
Two women in their 80s, sisters, no AC, very hot, one is dizzy. Some water.
Baby 4 months, formula for about two days, mum's ok. Toilet doesn't work.
Concentrator plugged into a car battery inverter, says maybe 2 hours on it. Lives alone, 77.
Didn't get much: older man, wouldn't open the door fully, said he's ok.
Four adults, food for a day, water for a day, no medical issues.
Type 2 diabetic on insulin, fridge works on generator, a week of insulin. Lives alone, 70.
Kidney dialysis, not sure when last session was, patient sleeping, wife answered.
Man about 50 with a CPAP, power out, he says he can manage a night without it.
Three kids alone, parents went to get supplies this morning, no water.
Retired couple, both fine, generator running, plenty of water and food, offered to help neighbours.
